sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Vivek Kumar Mishra - Advocate for the petitioner.
Shri B.P.S. Chouhan - Public Prosecutor for the respond  ORDER 1.

This is first application under Section 482 of B.N.S.S. (438 of Cr.P.C) filed by the applicant apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.23/2025, registered at Police Station- Kotwali,
District Datia (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC.

2. According to the prosecution story, on 03.05.2019, the present applicant/accused in collusion with revenue officials, obtained a fake land certificate for agricultural land bearing survey numbers 243 and 265, a certificate for water resources and other things and apart from this, he obtained loan by presenting forged documents in his own name.
In this regard a complaint was made to the concerned Superintendent of Police and after investigation, the crime was registered against the present applicant.

3. It is the submission of learned counsel for applicant that applicant is apprehending his arrest on the basis of registration of offence as referred NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:16850 2 MCRC-20776-2025 above.
The applicant is 62 years old person and he is a businessman and he has been falsely implicated in this case.

Initially a fake and concocted FIR at crime no.0023/2025 has been lodged by the complainant against the present applicant, making totally false and frivolous story due to business revenges and consequent to the same the concerning police is trying to drag the applicant into so called offence, while applicant has no where any concerned with the offence.

The applicant has lodged an FIR against the complainant with regard to his criminal act, therefore,
as a counter blast the present false case has been registered against the applicant by the Ajay Kumar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196433390/

sentences.text: There is no possibility of his absconsion or tempering with the evidence.
Jail incarceration of the applicant is causing hardship to him and his family.
Trial will take its own time.
The applicant is ready and willing to abide by any condition which may be imposed by this Court in case of grant of bail.
On the basis of the above submissions, he prays for anticipatory bail.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of application.

5. Heard the counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6.

Considering the submissions advanced by learned counsel for parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, it appears that it is a dispute of civil nature, hence, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court intends to allow the application.

Hence, it is hereby directed that in the event of arrest, applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:16850 3 MCRC-20776-2025 Arresting Authority/Investigating Officer.

7. This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicant:-
(1). The applicant will comply with all the terms and conditions of the bond executed by him;
(2). The applicant will cooperate in the investigation/ trial, as the case may be; (3).
The applicant will not indulge himself in extending inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him/her from disclosing such facts to the Court or to the Police Officer, as the case may be.
(4). The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused;

(5). The applicant will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial; (6). The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be;
8. Application stands allowed and disposed of.
9. Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court/Police Station concerned for compliance.
10. Certified copy as per rules.
(MILIND RAMESH PHADKE) JUDGE neetu Ajay Kumar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196433390/
